drawings.description: à gauche, un dessin de graphe : une douzaine de sommets marqués d'un point, des arêtes droites et courbes, deux arêtes doubles joignant les mêmes sommets, une arête isolée et un sommet isolé
drawings.kind: graph with multiple edges, an isolated edge and an isolated vertex
drawings.notes: Pencil graph: vertices marked by dots, straight and curved edges; a double edge (two curves) from the central vertex down to the bottom vertex, and a lens of two curves on the left; an isolated edge and an isolated vertex at the right. Which strokes end at a vertex on the left lens is a reading (the dots there are faint); a short stroke at the lower right is left out. Not encoded: the vertex set is not certain enough for a combinatorial schema.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, deux dessins : au crayon, un contour à deux sommets et deux arêtes ; à l'encre, un pentagone
drawings.kind: contour with two vertices and two edges; pentagon
drawings.notes: A contour of two vertices joined by two edges (a lens), and a pentagon with marked vertices. On the render the lens is the heavier stroke and the pentagon the lighter one, the reverse of what the transcription says (pencil lens, ink pentagon); both are drawn as on the page.
drawings.disagreement: The lens (contour with two vertices) is heavily inked and the pentagon light, not pencil lens and ink pentagon.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, deux petits dessins : deux arcs orientés mis bout à bout, puis un arc de $s$ vers $u_\omega(s)$ marqué $\sigma^{-1}s$ ; plus bas, l'arc $a$ d'origine $\sigma a$ suivi de l'arc $u_\omega(a)$, d'origine $\sigma u_\omega(a)$
drawings.kind: oriented arcs: s to u_omega(s); a followed by u_omega(a)
drawings.notes: Top: two oriented arcs end to end. Then an arc from s towards u_omega(s), marked sigma^{-1}s. Lower: the arc a with origin sigma a, followed by the arc u_omega(a) with origin sigma u_omega(a). The small labels are placed after the transcription.
